title: SN TOOL STUDIO PRO - Official Update v1.1.7 (Ultra-Fast 50%-60% Translation Engine & Smart Auto-Failover Pro)
subtitle: A major update (v1.1.7) is available with Ultra-Fast 50%–60% Translation Engine, 12-Second Cloud Auto-Failover, and Power Tools Output directory fix.
release_notes:
• ⚡ Ultra-Fast 50%–60% Translation Engine: Dynamic live chunk progress reporting (50%–68%) with continuous line counter so the UI never appears frozen during script translation!
• 🛡️ 12-Second Cloud Auto-Failover: Reduced API socket timeouts from 120s to 12s with automatic instantaneous failover, eliminating long 2-minute pipeline hangs!
• 🔄 Smooth Micro-Progress Pipeline: Real-time visual ticks and animated pulse indicators during drama script translation across both Single-Video and Batch Engines!
• 📂 Power Tools Output Directory Fix: Merged videos now output directly into the source drama directory and auto-highlight in Windows Explorer!
• 🎙️ Speech-to-Text Upload Optimization: Reduced audio upload timeout from 300s to 40s with instant failover to ultra-fast 3-second Groq Whisper when needed!
• 👄 Zero-Lag Lip-Sync Alignment: Synchronized Khmer dubbing directly to visual mouth opening with 130ms ADR anticipation lead - zero delay!
